summary: Phase 1 Online Member Self-Signup (iteration 216g) backend testing complete. All 27 tests passed (100%). Public signup endpoints (branding, plans, draft, parq, checkout) and Stripe Connect endpoints (status, onboarding-link, link-existing, disconnect) all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Public signup endpoints correctly require no auth - accessible for member self-signup
PARQ clearance logic correctly flags any 'yes' answer with clearance_required=true
Draft endpoint is idempotent - same draft_id updates instead of creating duplicate
Checkout endpoint correctly returns 400 with clear message when gym has no stripe_account_id
Stripe Connect endpoints properly enforce master admin authorization (403 for non-admins)
Platform fee correctly set to 1.0% as per spec
Link-existing endpoint validates acct_ prefix before calling Stripe API
Stripe API errors return 400 with error message (not 500 crash) - proper error handling
seed_data_creation: Test drafts created with TEST_ prefix emails during testing (auto-cleaned by test isolation)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Online Member Self-Signup backend fully tested. All public signup endpoints (GET /branding, GET /plans, POST /draft, POST /parq, POST /checkout, GET /status) and Stripe Connect endpoints (GET /status, POST /onboarding-link, POST /link-existing, POST /dashboard-link, DELETE /disconnect) working correctly. Stripe Connect calls hit real Stripe API - 400 errors from Stripe are expected behavior (not bugs). Frontend testing was skipped per request.

public_signup_endpoints: GET /api/public/signup/{slug}/branding - returns 200 with gym info + 7 PARQ questions (no auth)
GET /api/public/signup/{slug}/plans - returns published plans for gym (no auth, even if empty)
POST /api/public/signup/{slug}/draft - saves partial signup with email + step + plan_id, returns draft_id, idempotent
POST /api/public/signup/{slug}/parq - saves PARQ answers, sets clearance_required=true if any 'yes'
POST /api/public/signup/{slug}/checkout - fails 400 with 'gym has not connected payments' when no stripe_account_id
stripe_connect_endpoints: GET /api/stripe-connect/orgs/{org}/status - master admin only, returns connected:false for un-connected org, includes platform_fee_percent:1.0
POST /api/stripe-connect/orgs/{org}/onboarding-link - master admin only, creates Stripe Express account or returns 400 with Stripe error (not 500)
POST /api/stripe-connect/orgs/{org}/link-existing - accepts acct_… id or rejects invalid format with 400
POST /api/stripe-connect/orgs/{org}/dashboard-link - fails 400 when org has no connected account
authorization_tests: All Stripe Connect endpoints return 403 for non-master-admin users
All public signup endpoints work without authentication
validation_tests: Draft requires valid email (rejects invalid format with 400)
Checkout requires both draft_id and plan_id (rejects missing with 400)
Link-existing rejects account_id not starting with 'acct_'

mocked_apis_list: Stripe Connect Express webhooks (account.updated) - only construct_event is wired; full webhook events not simulated in this test pass
